## Create [Qdrant Collection](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/collections/) for Hybrid Search
The collection used for **Hybrid Search** is configured here with two types of vectors:

**1. [Dense Vectors](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/vectors/#dense-vectors)**
In this pipeline, we're using the [**mxbai-embed-large-v1**](https://huggingface.co/mixedbread-ai/mxbai-embed-large-v1) embedding model through Qdrant's Cloud Inference. Hence, we need to specify during the collection configuration its:
- **Dimensions**: 1024  
- **Similarity metric**: `cosine`


**2. [Sparse Vectors](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/vectors/#sparse-vectors)**
Qdrant’s main mechanism for setting up **keyword-based retrieval**. 
For example, you can set up retrieval with:
  - [**BM25**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Okapi_BM25) (used in this pipeline);
    - Qdrant provides an [**`IDF` modifier**](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/indexing/#idf-modifier) for sparse vectors. This enables Qdrant to calculate **inverse document frequency (IDF)** statistics on the server side. These statistics evaluate the importance of keywords, for example, in BM25.  
  - SPLADE, miniCOIL and other sparse neural retrievers.

## 1. Extract text from file
- For PDFs, we use Mistral OCR to extract text & images.

## Chunking Strategy

1. **Markdown Section Splitter**:
   - Parse markdown by headers (H1-H6)
   - Build hierarchical section titles like: **"Get Started > Managed Returns overview > Setup"**
   - Output one section per heading with its content

2. **Chunk Long Sections**:
   - Check each section's character count.
   - If > 1000 characters (configurable), split using recursive text splitter
   - Maintain the same sectionTitle for all sub-chunks 
   - Default chunk size and overlap:
      - **Chunk size:** 1000 characters
      - **Chunk overlap:** 0 characters (not needed in this scenario)

## Index Text Chunks to Qdrant Using External Embedding Provider (OpenAI)
*Don't forget to create and configure a separate collection for OpenAI’s [`text-embedding-3-small`](https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/text-embedding-3-small) embeddings.*

1. **Embed texts in batches** with OpenAI's [`text-embedding-3-small`](https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/text-embedding-3-small), generating dense vectors.  

2. **Upsert batches to Qdrant:**
- Pass pre-embedded by OpenAi dense vectors to Qdrant;
- Sparse representations for BM25 are created automatically under the hood by Qdrant.

# Avalara Managed Returns 

## Get started

## Managed Returns overview

Learn about Managed Returns, its features, and benefits.
Avalara Managed Returns is an automated returns filing solution, which is ideal for larger businesses wanting to offload a part of the returns process and reduce costs. This filing solution automates sales tax preparation, filing remittance, and notice management. It supports state and local jurisdictions across the United States and Canada.

Following are the benefits of using Managed Returns:

## - Time saving

Managed Returns saves time by:

- Exporting sales data instantly with auto-populated forms.
- Accessing filing schedules and rules for every jurisdiction through a single dashboard.
- Paying once to all jurisdictions in few easy steps.
- Archiving and storing records digitally for easy retrieval.


## - Cost saving

Managed Returns saves cost by:

- Reducing the cost of outsourcing for manual filing.
- Managing returns within your other business applications.
- Enabling resource focus on revenue-generating tasks.
- Growing and scaling without slowing your business.


## - Risk mitigation

Managed Returns mitigates risks by:

- Providing easy access to records.

- Providing detailed state liability reports.
- Providing minimized disruption during an audit.


# Browsers supported 

Identify the supported browsers to use returns.
Returns is compatible with the current version of the following browsers:

- Chrome
- Safari
- Firefox
- Edge


## Filing frequencies

Learn about different filing frequencies to choose from while you set up your returns.
Each state determines how often you need to file sales tax returns-this is called your filing frequency.

## Check with your state

Filing frequency rules vary by state. Always check your state's Department of Revenue (DOR) website for your assigned frequency.

## Important deadlines

- To change your filing frequency, submit your request by the last day of the month before the new frequency takes effect.

Example: To switch from monthly to quarterly starting January 1, 2024, request the change by December 31, 2023.

- In Hawaii, Michigan, and Rhode Island, businesses filing monthly, quarterly, or semiannually must also file an annual reconciliation return. Contact the DOR if you're unsure.

## Add a user

## Before you begin

Ensure you have the first name, last name, and email address for the user you want to add.

## About this task

Use this task to grant account-level or company-level access to a new user and assign them a role that defines what they can view or do in Avalara.

If you're migrating from CertCapture and need users to access Transactions, Returns, Registrations, Tax content, and specific companies for Exemption certificates, follow the instructions in the blue information box in the UI. For more information, see Manage users in CertCapture.

If you have also subscribed to Avalara E-Invoicing and Live Reporting and want to create a user, see Create user.

## Steps

1. From the Avalara Home, go to Account > Users and admins.

Alternatively, go to Account > Account overview, and then select Manage users under Users. The Users page appears.
2. Select Add a user. The Add a user page appears.
3. Enter the user's first name, last name, and email address.
4. In the Access and role section, choose the level of access:

- Select Account access: Grant the user full access to your account, including all companies and settings.
- Select Company access: Grant the user access to everything within a specific company, including child companies. Choose the appropriate company from the Company list.

5. In the Role section, assign roles for the user to determine their permissions. For Registrations, Transactions, Payables, Exemption certificates, Reports, and Integrations, available roles include:

- Administrator: Users can create and manage a user role, can view, and edit account or company information. They can submit payments, manage payment methods, update billing contacts, manage autopay enrollment, edit transactions, and change company settings.

Tip
Users need account access with account permissions to change billing information. Users with account access and limited access user permissions can't update billing information.

- Exemption-only: Users have access only to Exemptions Certificate Management (ECM). The Exemptions navigation option is visible in Avalara.

Note
Avalara manages exemption certificate access and permissions separately. The admin can adjust those permissions after sending the invite.

For more information, see Assign role and access to user.

- Viewer: Users can navigate and view anything, generate reports, and download reports.

They can view transaction data but can't edit information in Avalara.

- No Access: Users can't access this product.

6. Select Add.

# Result 

Avalara sends an email to the newly added user to create a password and get started. If the invitation expires, you can reset the password.

For more information, see Reset your Avalara password

# Change your Avalara password 

## Before you begin

Ensure that the password you want to set follows the password guidelines recommended by Avalara:

- The password must be at least eight characters in length. However, we recommend 10-12 characters.
- The passwords must contain an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number, and a symbol.
- Passwords must not contain the username, the word password, or other common passwords, which have been identified by Avalara Security.
- You can't use previously set passwords.


## About this task

Avalara emphasizes on account security so we recommend that you change your AvaTax account password periodically. The password doesn't expire. However, we recommend changing your password if there's a risk that your password is compromised.

## Steps

1. From the Avalara Home, go to Account > Changed password.
2. Enter your Current and New passwords.
3. Select Save.

## Result

The Password Strength Meter encourages creating robust and secure passwords. The Meter uses color coding as feedback: Red for poor, yellow for OK, and green for strong passwords.

## Managed Returns overview

Learn about Managed Returns, its features, and benefits.
Avalara Managed Returns is an automated returns filing solution, which is ideal for larger businesses wanting to offload a part of the returns process and reduce costs. This filing solution automates sales tax preparation, filing remittance, and notice management. It supports state and local jurisdictions across the United States and Canada.

Following are the benefits of using Managed Returns:

## - Time saving

Managed Returns saves time by:

- Exporting sales data instantly with auto-populated forms.
- Accessing filing schedules and rules for every jurisdiction through a single dashboard.
- Paying once to all jurisdictions in few easy steps.
- Archiving and storing records digitally for easy retrieval.


## - Cost saving

Managed Returns saves cost by:

- Reducing the cost of outsourcing for manual filing.
- Managing returns within your other business applications.
- Enabling resource focus on revenue-generating tasks.
- Growing and scaling without slowing your business.


## - Risk mitigation

Managed Returns mitigates risks by:

- Providing easy access to records.

- Providing detailed state liability reports.
- Providing minimized disruption during an audit.

- To change your filing frequency, submit your request by the last day of the month before the new frequency takes effect.

## - Scenario 1: First-time filing with Avalara:
$20^{\text {th }}$ of the month for your first filing period.
Example: To file January returns in February, set them up by January 20 at 5:00 p.m. PT. For example, to file July returns, submit the form by June 20.
Also submit your Funding Power of Attorney (FPOA) by the $20^{\text {th }}$. If updating an existing FPOA, submit by the end of the month.
- Scenario 2: Editing a return Avalara has already filed before
Make edits by the last day of the month before the next filing month.
Examples:
- To edit your January return (monthly filing frequency), make changes by January 31.
- To change to quarterly filing starting in July, update the frequency by June 30.
- Scenario 3: Updating a return (for example, filing frequency or account information)
Submit changes by the end of the month before the changes take effect.
Example: If the change applies in April, set it up by March 31.

## Avalara AvaTax overview
Introduces AvaTax, its core functionality, and key benefits. Includes onboarding and setup resources for new users.
Avalara AvaTax is a cloud-based solution for calculating sales tax, seller use tax, consumer use tax, and VAT/GST in real time. It uses current rates and rules based on geolocation, item taxability, tax holidays, product exemptions, and jurisdiction-specific laws.

## What AvaTax considers
- Tax rates by country, state/province, county, and city
- Local tax rules, boundaries, and special cases

## Key benefits - Automated tax calculations: Reduce manual work and support your team without adding headcount. - Improved accuracy: Avoid underpayment or overpayment that can result in fines. - Street-level accuracy: Use geospatial data for precise rate calculation more accurate than ZIP code-based estimates. If you've purchased a combination of Avalara products, you can manage all users from a single interface. These products function independently and have distinct roles and permission structures. - Centralized user access: Admins can manage all users from 1 unified interface, regardless of the number or type of Avalara products in use.
- Product-specific roles: Assign different roles and permissions to each user, specific to each product.

- Efficiently administer user accounts across products.
- Assign and update roles without switching between different user management systems.
- Ensure consistency and reduce duplication when managing user identities across Avalara services.

## Managed Returns overview
Learn about Managed Returns, its features, and benefits.
Avalara Managed Returns is an automated returns filing solution, which is ideal for larger businesses wanting to offload a part of the returns process and reduce costs. This filing solution automates sales tax preparation, filing remittance, and notice management. It supports state and local jurisdictions across the United States and Canada.
Following are the benefits of using Managed Returns:

## - Time saving
Managed Returns saves time by:
- Exporting sales data instantly with auto-populated forms.
- Accessing filing schedules and rules for every jurisdiction through a single dashboard.
- Paying once to all jurisdictions in few easy steps.
- Archiving and storing records digitally for easy retrieval.

## - Cost saving
Managed Returns saves cost by:
- Reducing the cost of outsourcing for manual filing.
- Managing returns within your other business applications.
- Enabling resource focus on revenue-generating tasks.
- Growing and scaling without slowing your business.

## - Risk mitigation
Managed Returns mitigates risks by:
- Providing easy access to records.
- Providing detailed state liability reports.
- Providing minimized disruption during an audit.

Avalara AvaTax is a cloud-based solution for calculating sales tax, seller use tax, consumer use tax, and VAT/GST in real time. It uses current rates and rules based on geolocation, item taxability, tax holidays, product exemptions, and jurisdiction-specific laws.

- Local tax rules, boundaries, and special cases

# AvaTax account 
Avalara assigns a unique account identification number to each subscriber to help Avalara identify your subscription.
Avalara assigns a unique account ID to every AvaTax subscription. This ID helps identify your subscription when you contact Avalara for support or services.
Avalara regularly updates Knowledge Center content and this document may be out of date. Please check back frequently for updates
When you subscribe to AvaTax and share the required details, Avalara provisions your account and assigns the ID. One AvaTax account can include multiple companies and users.
Users in your account can have different roles. Each role controls what they can see and do in AvaTax. You can invite users to help with onboarding or ongoing tasks.
To add an implementation partner or assistant during onboarding, make them an account administrator. This role gives them full access.

## AvaTax company
Learn about what is a company in AvaTax.
In AvaTax, you create a company to represent your legal business entity. Your first company is created
during the onboarding stage. After completing the onboarding, you can add child or subsidiary companies to replicate your business setup.
A company can have users. Avalara creates the first user who is the account administrator for your company during provisioning.
When performing important setup activities, ensure that you've selected the required active company. For more information on company management, See Company in Avalara Portal.

# (i) Note 
You can't make the company inactive if you have only one company. However, if you have more than one company, you can make the first company, restricted earlier, inactive. You must always have one active company.

## User management
Manage users across multiple Avalara products and services with centralized user management functionality.
Avalara's user management functionality provides a seamless, centralized experience for administrators managing users across multiple Avalara products and services.
If you've purchased a combination of Avalara products, you can manage all users from a single interface. These products function independently and have distinct roles and permission structures. However, they often require the same set of users to be assigned and managed across platforms. Key capabilities include:
- Centralized user access: Admins can manage all users from 1 unified interface, regardless of the number or type of Avalara products in use.
- Product-specific roles: Assign different roles and permissions to each user, specific to each product.
With this centralized experience, you can:
- Efficiently administer user accounts across products.

- Assign and update roles without switching between different user management systems.
- Ensure consistency and reduce duplication when managing user identities across Avalara services.
The different roles and permissions for Avalara AvaTax and Avalara E-Invoicing and Live Reporting (ELR) are as follows:
- AvaTax user roles and permission
- Avalara E-Invoicing and Live Reporting (ELR) user roles and permission
